picks.thesis: Steep curve (2s10s +41bp) with 2Y above funds rate says the market is pricing tighter-for-longer into the Sept 15-16 FOMC; equities are rangebound and post-earnings software wreckage (PANW -10%, DDOG -6%, CRWD -6%) is the only fresh dislocation with a known behavioral base rate. Mostly cash is correct.
picks.justification: Doctrine first: review existing positions before new ideas. XLE and XLU are both intact — no invalidation triggered, small size, hold. The racing mandate does not override SOUL §9: survive, measure honestly, compound — I will not manufacture trades to chase a 10x. One new position clears the three-sentence test: PANW's -10% earnings gap invokes post-earnings-announcement drift, a documented behavioral edge where dip-buying retail anchored to the pre-print price supplies the other side. NVDA's earnings are already past (Aug 26) and today's +3.5% offers no underwritable edge; crypto shows no mispricing I can name; ~81% stays in cash earning the front-end yield, which at FF 3.63% is a legitimate position.

positions.thesis: HOLD — energy underweight by generalists plus steep-curve/reflation regime; mechanism intact, marginally green, no invalidation hit.
positions.invalidation: We are wrong if XLE closes below 60.40 (-7%) or WTI-driven sector flows reverse (XLE bottom-quartile sector performer for 10 consecutive sessions) by 2026-10-15.

positions.thesis: HOLD — utilities as defensive carry into FOMC uncertainty; note the falsifier is rates: 2Y at 4.34% above funds is a headwind, so this position lives on a tight leash.
positions.invalidation: We are wrong if 10Y yield closes above 5.00% or XLU closes below 40.55 (-5%) by 2026-10-02 — a hawkish FOMC repricing kills the defensive-carry mechanism.

positions.thesis: Post-earnings-announcement drift: a -10% earnings gap historically continues in the gap direction over 2-6 weeks; alpha is supplied by retail dip-buyers anchored to the pre-print $362 price, a bias that persists because anchoring doesn't update on one print.
positions.invalidation: We are wrong if PANW reclaims and closes above $352 (a full close of the earnings gap) by 2026-09-23, or rises 8% from entry (~$352) at any point — gap reclamation means the market judged the reaction an overshoot and the drift mechanism is dead.

picks.thesis: Remain flat: a steep curve, 4.75% 10-year yield, and the September 15–16 FOMC create uncertain cross-asset conditions without a sufficiently validated mispricing.
picks.justification: There are no existing positions to hold or sell. No new position passes the evidence gate because prices are supplied by only one source, while the research feed is dated around August 26 and incorrectly frames already-reported Nvidia earnings as upcoming; the required independent price confirmation and current catalyst evidence are therefore absent. Preserve capital in cash rather than manufacture conviction from inconsistent inputs.

picks.thesis: Steep curve and 4.75% 10Y with VIX 16.3 price a soft-landing grind into the Sep 15–16 FOMC; nothing in the tape is clearly mispriced versus that, so cash is the position.
picks.justification: Book is flat with no open theses to re-underwrite. Headlines are stale or non-actionable (NVDA already reported Aug 26; PANW/CRWD/NET/DDOG dumps lack a stated mechanism). No three-sentence edge survives: no named payer of alpha, no falsifier tighter than a vibe, and event risk in 13 days makes chasing beta a process error. Survive-measure-compound binds over the 10x race prompt; inventing names to look busy would be drift.
